description:
KryptoNow is a secure, non-custodial Web3 wallet that gives you full control of your crypto — no middlemen, no custody.

🔐 SECURITY FIRST
• Private keys stored exclusively on your device (Secure Enclave / iOS Keychain)
• Biometric lock with Face ID / Touch ID
• Social recovery for lost devices
• Hardware wallet support (Ledger)

💸 TRADE & EARN
• Swap 100+ tokens across Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base
• Best rates via 1inch DEX aggregation
• Bridge assets cross-chain (Across, Stargate, Hop, Relay)
• Buy crypto with card via MoonPay, Transak, Ramp & Simplex
• Earn yield with Aave, Lido, and top DeFi protocols

🌐 WEB3 READY
• WalletConnect v2 — connect to any dApp
• ERC-4337 Account Abstraction (gasless transactions)
• Full NFT gallery with BNB, Ethereum & Polygon support
• Built-in dApp browser

📊 PORTFOLIO & ANALYTICS
• Live portfolio tracking with price charts
• Price alerts for any token
• Full transaction history
• Multi-chain balance aggregation

🤖 AI ASSISTANT
• Ask anything about crypto, DeFi, or your portfolio
• Powered by Groq (Llama 3)

✨ PREMIUM EXPERIENCE
• Light, Dark, and Pro (gold) themes
• Transaction simulation before sending (Tenderly)
• Batch send to multiple addresses
• Referral program — earn rewards

KryptoNow is free to download. Pro subscription unlocks 0% swap fees and advanced features.

review_information.notes:
This is a non-custodial crypto wallet. To test core functionality:
1. Tap 'Create New Wallet' on the first screen
2. A seed phrase is generated on-device — no account needed
3. The Dashboard shows a zero balance (new wallet)
4. Swap, Buy, Bridge, and Receive screens are accessible from the dashboard
5. WalletConnect allows connecting to test dApps at app.uniswap.org

Note: Real crypto transactions require funded wallets. No demo credentials needed — the app works without an account (Clerk sign-in is optional for push notifications and referral tracking).
